decisions.reason: The firm builds finned tubes on core heat-transfer knowledge it holds well, but the product has not appeared on the website since 2019 and the firm has already pruned closely related launches, so it will likely fold the knowledge into its established air-cooler business rather than keep a separate product.

The firm's own R&D and EU project experience mean the enhanced-tube know-how can be absorbed across the wider exchanger portfolio, but the product has been missing from the website since 2019 and the firm has a record of consolidating new lines, so a separate offering is unlikely to continue.
